status: Source release; Surface Pro 11 Denali OLED capture, stop/cleanup, cold-boot and suspend (idle and streaming, CX/AOSS/DDR collapse) checks passed on 7.3.0-25.1-omarchy-isp 2026-11-07; other boards unqualified

base_recipe.describes: Omarchy linux-omarchy (aarch64) 7.3-25 as omarchy-pkgs#1698 77314411 (Omarchy 7.3-24 plus 2217), plus 2221 (DisplayPort audio) and the quiet-efivarfs initramfs hook

recipe_changes: pkgbase and _kernel renamed to linux-omarchy-isp; no conflicts/replaces, installs next to linux-omarchy
ISP patches 3300-3368 appended to source=() (byte-identical to the 7.2.8-13.1 series 2300-2368, renumbered), plus 3369 (post-init-providers on the ICP/BPS/IPE nodes so sync_state runs)
package() writes /usr/lib/modules/<release>/qualcomm-isp-manifest.json for the runtime preflight and unit conditions
quiet-efivarfs hook sources left out (linux-omarchy owns the hook)
